title: Functional Safety Engineer
summary: Makes sure car electronics fail safely, by finding hazards, setting safety goals and checking designs against the ISO 26262 standard. Works across system, hardware and software teams at automotive suppliers and carmakers, and owns the safety case (the evidence that the product is safe enough).
dailyDuties: Run hazard analysis and risk assessment workshops
Write safety goals and safety concept documents
Lead DFMEA, FMEDA and fault tree analysis
Trace safety requirements to design and tests in DOORS or Polarion
Review designs and test results for safety gaps
Prepare work products for safety audits and assessments

skills.expectation: Apply ISO 26262 across the lifecycle, including HARA, ASIL assignment and FMEDA
Write safety goals, functional and technical safety concepts and the safety case
Lead DFMEA at system, hardware or software level
Build fault trees and dependent failure analyses for safety goals
Manage safety requirements and traceability in DOORS, Polarion or Codebeamer
Explain safety findings to engineering teams, customers and assessors
Work inside Automotive SPICE processes and support assessments
Understand AUTOSAR software architecture where safety mechanisms live
Read embedded C to review software safety mechanisms
Plan safety validation tests that run on HIL benches
Work on ADAS features where SOTIF applies alongside ISO 26262

certifications.why: Widely asked ISO 26262 credential for automotive safety roles
